Path: business reporting | dashboards.chart-type-matrix | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `normalizeChartSchema`'s x-axis presentation gate (`xAxisSpec.format || xAxisSpec.title || xAxisSpec.showGridLines !== undefined`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: an `xAxis` object's declared `min` / `max` / `stepSize` / `logarithmic` / `position` are dropped silently unless one of three unrelated keys is present; dataset-bound scatter widgets reach it today. A declared key dropped without a word ⇒ p2.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T08:56Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`. Dedupe by this seat over 725 objectui cards (open, plus closed since 2026-09-18): `normalizeChartSchema` → 4 hits (this card; #10518, its sibling; #8760 and #9675, closed).

Execution note: keep the x-axis object whenever it carries ANY declared presentation key; pin per key, with the `title` case as the control. Same family as #10518.

Claim: PM loop round 4 — `domain:ui` execution seat 2
Session: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`

Added by the seat after the dev report, because the change made their published text false (prose and comment only): the `plugin-charts.mdx` caveat line, and the `axisPresentation` docblock in `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts`. No open PR touches either (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — `dispatch-gates --tier`: 「no path-derived mandate … floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable」; executes triage `5829695041` (keep the x-axis object whenever it carries any declared presentation key)
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5829695041
Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-25T09:02Z. No open PR touches `normalizeChartSchema.ts`. This seat's objectui#8086 (PR objectui#10554, in the merge queue) edits `ChartRenderer.tsx`, and objectui#8885 (in flight) edits `ObjectChart.tsx`: different files. Live `pm:dispatched` claims of seats 1, 3, 4 and 5 name no `normalizeChartSchema.ts`. objectui#10518 (the `@object-ui/types` half of this family) is unclaimed and a different file.

`Clause-②: no` — declared axis keys stop being dropped by the normaliser; no export, schema or accept set moves.

### Findings, each with its disposition

- Dev, class b, confirmed at source by the reviewer: `xAxis.position` survives normalisation, but no renderer reads it (no `orientation` on any `XAxis`; only the y side reads `position === 'right'`). The inert site moves from the normaliser to the renderer, where it is consistent, and the changeset states it ⇒ **to be filed by the seat** (dedupe words: xAxis position top ignored; x axis position inert).
- Reviewer: `min` / `max` / `stepSize` / `logarithmic` also reach category (bar/line) x axes, which read only `format` / `title` / `showGridLines`. This matches the docs row ("the x axis of a `scatter` chart") ⇒ **recorded**, and it folds into the same card.
- Reviewer nit: in the "falsy values" pin row, `showGridLines: false` was already kept on base. The row is still red on base via `min: 0` / `logarithmic: false` ⇒ **Acceptance notes**.
